operatorJsonValue.$comment: Intentionally opaque operator-owned JSON. This recursive seam is used only below `operatorWorkflowInput`; eval-owned keys and all other eval contracts remain closed.

operatorWorkflowInput.$comment: Operator-defined workflow input is intentionally open, but it must be an object and cannot shadow eval-owned benchmark controls or the runner's ultrafuzz_eval envelope.

evalSuiteInput.$comment: Canonical current-only operator-authored eval suite input. Defaults are applied only after this closed schema succeeds; the retained Zod parser is non-transforming and parity-tested against this definition.
